item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
very true…partially why i see it as a likely disinformation document. I mean, The Foundation seems to have a timeless vibe, is/was/will be and all that. Then again, it'd be easy to slip a actual, real record of the early Foundation in the middle of all the bullshit and have it slide unmarked, just to mess with people.

For me, i think The Foundation has always existed in one form or another, with the current incarnation germinating somewhere between world war one and two.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I love living in the future! All you have to do is ask the question.

Slides started in the 1860s-1870s.

Considering the Foundation obsessions with keeping records (even though this isn't them but the Foundation's parent), this actually fits in well.

Actually, the agency names are what truly date this - MI5 started after WWII, FBI started in 1908, and the KGB in 1954…

item.content:encoded: Possably, but at the base level, the CI are The Foundation with a even smaller ethics board. The GOC has more of a "kill'em all" approach to items…also, for the record, in my head the CI doesn't actually exist. Just a easy label developed by The Foundation to slap on to rogue Agents and sites that slip from direct oversight.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Maybe they weren't. Maybe at the time, slide projection was state-of-the-art, and well outside the public area. remember, Radar was labled top secret at one point.

Also, there's a gag in the title that i felt compelled to point out. The Foundation loves to spread disinformation, and keep both staff and outside agents massively confused. They'll seed rumors, spread outright lies, all to keep a nice, thick layer of confusion over everything. This document seems to detail how they got started, outlining connection to outside agencies and generally providing something of a bombshell for anyone finding it. And it was found on storage level B-8
